text: Program Description Engineering management is a new interdisciplinary subject of engineering technology and management. This major cultivates compound senior management talents who have basic knowledge of management, economics and civil engineering technology, and master theories, methods and methods of modern management science. Project management consists of engineering management major, awarded bachelor's degree in management or engineering, the future can be engaged in engineering construction and real estate industry at home and abroad project decision, project investment and financing, project management and management of the whole process.
